Name: Tool Swap Tractor Mod
Author: batatarei
Description:
Tool Swap Tractor Mod
Description
[b]Tool Swap Tractor Mod[/b] is a quality-of-life SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley that automatically switches your active toolbar slot to the appropriate tool or item based on nearby targets while driving the tractor.

Instead of manually cycling through your hotbar to switch between your Pickaxe, Axe, Scythe, Hoe, Seeds, or Fertilizer, this mod scans your surroundings in real time and equips the right tool for the job automatically—letting you clear fields, harvest crops, and plant seeds seamlessly.

Main Features
[list]
[*][b]Smart Hotbar Swapping:[/b] Automatically selects the correct tool slot (Pickaxe for stones, Axe for trees/logs, Scythe for weeds/crops, Hoe for tilled soil, etc.) as you drive over targets.
[/*]
[*][b]TractorMod Dynamic Sync:[/b] Respects your active settings in [i]TractorMod[/i] and [i]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/i] in real time (e.g., if tree chopping is disabled in TractorMod, the mod will not switch to the Axe for trees).
[/*]
[*][b]Fruit Tree Safety Lock:[/b] Built-in safeguards strictly prevent auto-chopping Fruit Trees to avoid accidental destruction.
[/*]
[*][b]On-Screen HUD Display:[/b] Draws a subtle, real-time HUD indicator showing your active tractor status, current detected target, and equipped tool.
[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Range Compatibility:[/b] Works seamlessly with mods that modify tractor range on the fly (such as [i]Questable Tractor[/i]).
[/*]
[*][b]Cutscene & Safety Guards:[/b] Automatically pauses functionality during cutscenes, dialogues, and event scenes to prevent unintended item switching.
[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b]
[code]1.6[/code]or higher.
[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]
[code]4.0.0[/code]or higher.
[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]TractorMod[/url][/b] [i](Required)[/i] — This mod extends and interacts directly with TractorMod's functionality.
[/*]
[/list]Installation Instructions
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [b][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/b].
[/*]
[*]Download and install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]TractorMod[/url][/b] into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.
[/*]
[*]Download the [b]Tool Swap Tractor Mod[/b] package.
[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]ToolSwapTractorMod[/code]folder directly into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.
[/*]
[*]Launch the game using
[code]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/code].
[/*]
[/list]Hotkeys & Controls
[list]
[*][code]J[/code][b]Key:[/b] Toggles automatic tool switching [b]ON / OFF[/b] on the fly.
[/*]
[*][code]L[/code][b]Key:[/b] Prints a diagnostic log to the SMAPI console showing current targets within range and assigned tool slots.
[/*]
[/list]Shout Outs
